names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 ianuarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Γεώργιος ο Χοζεβίτης», with the rank word left off.
Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 8 января ст. ст., «Георгий Хозевит, прп.», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life gives one year, the Persian invasion: «Înainte de a năvăli păgânii perși (614) Sfântul Gheorghe a prorocit căderea Ierihonului și împresurarea Ierusalimului.» He survived it, returned to Chozeba and «a rămas zăvorât până la sfârșitul zilelor lui», so 614 is a lower bound and the page gives no upper one.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 января ст. ст. — «Прп. Георгия Хозевита (VII).»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 8 Ιανουαρίου — «Όσιος Γεώργιος ο Χοζεβίτης»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs and the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Gheorghe, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Gheorghe Hozevitul», Glasul 8

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren desert, and with sighing from the depths thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou wast made a lamp to the world, shining with wonders, O George our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Lumină prealuminoasă te-ai arătat, Sfinte Părinte Gheorghe, strălucind cu Razele cele Dumnezeieşti, pe cei ce cu credinţă te cheamă pe tine. Roagă-te pentru noi lui Hristos Mântuitorul, Care S-a arătat în Iordan şi a luminat pe cei zidiţi din pământ.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Condacul Sfântului Cuvios Gheorghe Hozevitul», Glasul 4, podobie «Arătatu-Te-ai astăzi...»

english.text: Thou wast shown to be a light most radiant, O holy Father George, shining with the divine rays upon those who call on thee in faith. Pray for us to Christ the Saviour, who was made manifest in the Jordan and gave light to those formed out of the earth.

hymns.text: Γεωργήσας τον λόγον Πάτερ της χάριτος, δικαιοσύνης έδρέψω καρποφορίαν λαμπράν, ως την ένθεον ζωήν αϊρετισάμενος, όθεν της δόξης κοινωνός, ανεδείχθης του Χριστού, Γεώργιε θεοφόρε' ώ και πρεσβεύεις άπαύστως, έλεηθήναι τάς ψυχάς ημών.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), Όσιος Γεώργιος ο Χοζεβίτης — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος πλ. α'. Τον συνάναρχον Λόγον

english.text: Having tilled the word of grace, father, you reaped a bright harvest of righteousness, since you had chosen the life that is filled with God; and so you were shown to be a sharer in the glory of Christ, God-bearing George, to whom you intercede without ceasing that our souls may be shown mercy.

hymns.text: Явился еси светило пресветлое, Георгие,/ озаряя Божественными зарями верно зовущия ти:/ моли о нас Владыку Христа,/ явльшагося во струях// и просвещшаго земнородныя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 января ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Георгия»

english.text: Thou hast appeared as a most radiant light, O George, illumining with divine rays those who faithfully call upon thee. Pray for us to Christ the Master, who was made manifest in the streams of Jordan and gave light to those born of earth.
